contract.task_clause:
Concerning the relationship between morality and theology, Bentham claims that:
Option A: we must first know whether something is right before we can know whether it conforms to God’s will.
Option B: we must first know whether something conforms to God’s will before we can know that it is right.
Option C: God exists, but does not concern himself with matters of morality.
Option D: God does not exist.
